outcome: Neonatal APGAR scores at 1 and 5 minutes
cohort: The study included 120 antenatal women undergoing elective or emergency caesarean section at a tertiary care hospital.
finding: Prophylactic intravenous TXA given prior to caesarean section significantly reduced mean total blood loss and the mean fall in hemoglobin at 24 hours without compromising maternal safety or neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Prophylactic intravenous TXA given prior to caesarean section effectively reduces blood loss and hemoglobin decline during caesarean deliveries.
